request.initial_prompt: Kutúzov's merit lay, not in any strategic maneuver of genius, as it is called, but in the fact that he alone understood the significance of what had happened. He alone then understood the meaning of the French army's inactivity, he alone continued to assert that the battle of Borodinó had been a victory, he alone—who as commander in chief might have been expected to be eager to attack—employed his whole strength to restrain the Russian army from useless engagements.

raw_segments.text: Kutúzov's merit lay, not in any strategic maneuver of genius, as it is called, but in the fact that he
alone understood the significance of what had happened. He alone then understood the meaning
of the French army's inactivity, he alone continued to assert that the battle of Borodinó
had been a victory, he alone—who as commander in chief might have been expected to be eager
to attack—employed his whole strength to restrain the Russian army from useless engagements.
